query: Item 7 Management's Discussion and Analysis (MD&A), and Item 8 Financial Statements and Supplementary Data sections specifically covering "Income Taxes" and "Commitments and Contingencies".

extraction.tax_onetime_note: One-time income tax charge of $10.2 billion recorded in Q4 2024 due to ECJ confirmation of European Commission State Aid Decision, representing $15.8 billion payable to Ireland via escrow release, net of $4.8 billion U.S. foreign tax credit and $823 million decrease in unrecognized tax benefits
extraction.tax_contingency_note: Gross unrecognized tax benefits of $22.0 billion as of September 28, 2024, of which $10.8 billion would impact effective tax rate; reasonably possible decrease of $5 billion to $13 billion in next 12 months primarily related to intercompany transfer pricing and deemed repatriation tax
